map.重音符号只标元音？: Does the accent mark only go on vowels?
map.是，西语重音符号只加在 a/e/i/o/u 上（ñ 是独立字母非重音）；á 等表: Yes. In Spanish the accent mark is added only to a, e, i, o, u (ñ is an independent letter, not an accented vowel); á indicates that the syllable is stressed.
map.疑问词一定标重音？: Do question words always take an accent?
map.是，疑问/感叹词（qué/cuándo/dónde）必标重音以区别于关系代词（q: Yes. Interrogative and exclamative words (qué, cuándo, dónde) always carry an accent to distinguish them from relative words (que, cuando); this is fixed usage.
